title: Depletion of davemaoite in Earth’s ambient lower mantle
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76943-0

Davemaoite remains cubic throughout most of the lower mantle and exhibits intrinsically low shear-wave velocities. Seismic constraints indicate that it is depleted in the ambient lower mantle but enriched within LLSVPs, likely as a result of late-stage crystallization during magma-ocean differentiation.

title: Atmospheric turbulence sensing with structured terahertz beams containing orbital angular momentum
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76743-6

This study introduces a method using structured THz-OAM beam to detect clear air turbulence. It overcomes optical limits by resisting saturation and misalignment, enabling robust turbulence strength sensing, hazard localization, and water vapor monitoring.

title: Quantifying the role of nitrogen in achieving global Sustainable Development Goals
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76777-w

Balanced nitrogen intake and lower nitrogen releases are linked to progress across the Sustainable Development Goals, helping align human well-being with environmental protection and highlighting the need for context-specific nitrogen management.

title: Focal mechanism variations reveal mechanical controls on segmentation at oceanic transform faults
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76407-5

The authors use thousands of small earthquakes to show that variations in fault zone strength control segmentation of oceanic transform faults and their distinct slip behaviors.

title: CD36-mediated lipid-accumulation in reactive microglia contributes to retinal degeneration via the NLRP3-IL-1β pathway in mice
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76685-z

Metabolic stress can reshape immune cells into drivers of tissue damage. This study identifies CD36-driven lipid accumulation in reactive microglia as a mechanism linking retinal inflammation to degeneration.

title: Ryugu and Bennu preserve primordial isotopic heterogeneity absent from the meteorite record
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76720-z

Samples returned from Ryugu and Bennu preserve primordial isotopic heterogeneity in major planet-building elements that is not represented in meteorite collections.

title: Achieving Near 21% Efficiency Organic Solar Cells through Controlled Packing of Fused-Ring Electron Acceptors
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76532-1

Non radiative energy loss remains a challenge in non-fullerene organic solar cells. Wei et al. introduce chlorobenzene-functionalized acceptors that exhibit enhanced photoluminescence quantum yield with a distinct molecular packing mode, enabling a power conversion efficiency of 20.92%.

title: Phosphorylation of OTUB1 promotes autophagy initiation under starvation
abstract:
Nature Communications, Published online: 15 August 2026; doi:10.1038/s41467-026-76796-7

This study uncovers a phosphorylation-dependent regulatory mechanism controlling OTUB1’s function in nutrient deficiency-triggered autophagy initiation, providing cellular and molecular evidence supporting the therapeutic potential of fasting in alleviating MASLD.
